# Vaccaro Construction Services

> Locally owned, owner-operated construction and home improvement. Bathroom remodeling, general home repairs, and small renovations, plus decks, carpentry, basements, and masonry. The owner does the work and deals directly with homeowners and property managers.

Website: https://vaccarocs.com/

## Services

- Bathroom remodeling: vanities, tile, fixtures, and full baths
- Home repairs: drywall, doors, trim, fixtures, and punch lists
- Small renovations: finishes, storage, and room updates
- Decks and exterior: entry stairs, decks, outdoor woodwork, and masonry
- Carpentry: islands, shelves, paneling, and built-ins
- Basements: paint, floors, and making the space usable

## How a job starts

1. The customer describes the space and what they want changed.
2. Vaccaro Construction Services looks at the job, on site or by talking it through.
3. The customer gets a proposal and a detailed scope of work.
4. The owner shows up, does the job, and stands behind it.

## Contact

Inquiries: https://vaccarocs.com/#contact
Email: vaccaroconstructionservices@gmail.com

The inquiry form asks for name, phone or email, town, project type, whether the customer is a homeowner or property manager, and a short description of the job.
